name: KKR
description: KKR is an investment firm that raises money from pension funds, insurers and wealthy investors and invests it in private equity, infrastructure, real estate and private credit ($744B of assets under management at Dec 31, 2025). It earns management fees on the capital it manages, a share of investment profits (carried interest and performance income) when investments are sold, and returns on its own capital. Since 2021 it also owns Global Atlantic, a life insurance and annuity company with $219B of assets, which KKR uses as a permanent pool of capital for its credit and other strategies and which earns the spread between what it earns on investments and what it owes policyholders. Fee-related earnings, the steadiest piece, were 74.5% of operating earnings in 2025.

gics.note: Conventional GICS label from general knowledge, not re-checked. SEC SIC code is 6282 (Investment Advice). The label hides that about a quarter of operating earnings come from an insurance company.

hq.note: From general knowledge; cover page not re-read in this pass.

employees.note: About 4,200: about 2,700 in Asset Management and about 1,500 in Insurance (Global Atlantic), plus about 800 more across subsidiary organizations (10-K)

businessLines.name: Asset Management (Fee Related Earnings)
businessLines.how: An annual percentage fee on committed or invested capital in funds, paid quarterly and locked in for years (funds run 10 or more years), plus deal-by-deal transaction fees from portfolio companies and its capital markets arm.
businessLines.description: Management fees, transaction and monitoring fees and fee-related performance revenues across Private Equity, Real Assets, and Credit and Liquid Strategies.

businessLines.name: Insurance (Global Atlantic)
businessLines.how: Global Atlantic sells annuities and life insurance and invests the premiums; profit is the spread between investment income and benefits owed to policyholders. KKR also earns asset management fees for managing much of Global Atlantic's portfolio.

businessLines.name: Strategic Holdings
businessLines.how: KKR's own balance-sheet stakes in a small group of core private-equity holdings; returns are dividends and operating earnings rather than fund fees.
